summary: Saint Joseph, the guardian of the family of Jesus, is a model of labor, humility, and fidelity to God’s plan.
antiphon_text: Let us remember Saint Joseph as a faithful witness to the love and mercy of Christ.
prayer_text: Lord God, through the life of Saint Joseph, strengthen us to follow your path with courage and charity. Grant us the grace to bear faithful witness in our own time. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
